mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before Frasheski Construction comes to repair my railing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before Frasheski Construction arrives for your railing repair, consider clearing the area around the railing to provide clear access for our team and equipment. This includes moving outdoor furniture, potted plants, or any other obstructions. If your railing is part of a deck or porch, ensuring clear access to all sides where work is needed helps streamline the repair process and avoids potential delays.
